title: Patch notes: Wylde's and Ishir's fixes
subtitle: FANGS Community Edition · 23 October 2026
intro: Two bug fixes from your reports.
To get it: start the game through the launcher as usual; it updates itself.

sections.name: Heroes
heroes: Sever Spirit (R): the shotgun sound plays once, when the mark pops. Ishir's player also heard it right when pressing R.
Fan the Hammers (Shift): fixed the first casts of a game firing 12 to 24 bullets. His gun could hold several magazines at once until his first reload of the game; now it never holds more than one.

outro: Thanks for the reports! Keep them coming.
